body:
# Grandia Dungeons Modpack

**Grandia Dungeons Modpack** is a dark fantasy dungeon roguelike modpack for **Minecraft Java 1.21.1** on **NeoForge**.

The pack is built around the custom **Grandia Dungeons** mod and focuses on dungeon-run gameplay: classes, bosses, cursed loot, magic items, traders, traps, dangerous rooms, custom UI and atmospheric progression.

Instead of normal vanilla survival, the main goal is to explore dungeon floors, collect loot, fight monsters, prepare for bosses and survive as long as possible.

## Features

* Dark fantasy dungeon roguelike gameplay
* Procedural dungeon floors
* Boss arenas and boss encounters
* Player classes, subclasses and skills
* Cursed weapons, armor, rings and artifacts
* Wands, staffs, grimoires, scrolls and potions
* Traders, cursed coins and dungeon economy
* Alchemy rooms and dungeon utility items
* Mimics, traps, dangerous rooms and rare loot
* Additional monsters and bosses
* Expanded combat and weapon variety
* Custom main menu and loading screen
* Russian and English menu/loading localization
* Multiplayer-friendly dungeon gameplay

## Gameplay

Grandia Dungeons Modpack changes the usual Minecraft progression into a dungeon-based adventure.

Each floor can contain enemies, loot, traps, special rooms, mimics, traders or boss encounters. The deeper you go, the more dangerous the dungeon becomes.

Cursed items can be powerful but risky. Resources matter, preparation is important, and boss fights should not be taken lightly.

## Atmosphere

The modpack is designed around a dark fantasy dungeon style: ancient stone halls, purple magic, cursed artifacts, torches, chains, ruins, crystals, dangerous monsters and boss fights.

The goal is to make the dungeon feel dangerous, mysterious and alive.

## Included Mods

### Core Gameplay and Dungeon Content

* **Grandia Dungeons** — the main custom dungeon roguelike mod of the pack
* **Epic Fight** — advanced combat system
* **Epic Fight Skill Tree** — skill tree support for Epic Fight
* **Born in Chaos** — dark fantasy monsters and enemies
* **L_Ender’s Cataclysm** — powerful bosses and PvE challenges
* **Bosses of Mass Destruction / BoMD** — additional boss encounters
* **Block Factory’s Bosses** — extra bosses and combat challenges
* **Trial Guardians** — additional hostile encounters
* **ArPhEx** — additional hostile creatures and dungeon threats
* **Mob Compack** — additional mobs and content
* **MCB Christmas** — extra themed content
* **Simply Swords** — expanded weapon variety
* **Simply Cataclysm** — Cataclysm-related additions
* **Biomes O’ Plenty** — additional biomes and world variety

### UI, Visuals and Client Features

* **FancyMenu** — custom main menu
* **Drippy Loading Screen** — custom loading screen
* **Simply Tooltips** — improved item tooltips
* **Ok Zoomer** — zoom functionality
* **NeoOculus** — shader support
* **Embeddium** — rendering optimization
* **Rubidium Extra** — additional video settings
* **Sodium Dynamic Lights** — dynamic lighting

### Performance and Technical Mods

* **FerriteCore** — memory optimization
* **GlitchCore** — technical support library
* **FDLib** — technical dependency
* **SmartBrainLib** — AI and entity behavior library
* **TerraBlender** — world generation support
* **Oracle Index** — technical dependency
* **Gnetum** — technical dependency

### Libraries and Dependencies

* **Architectury API**
* **AzureLib**
* **Cerbons API**
* **Cloth Config**
* **Curios API**
* **DeciLib**
* **Fzzy Config**
* **GeckoLib**
* **Konkrete**
* **Melody**
* **Kotlin for Forge**
* **Lionfish API**
* **Owo Lib**

Some listed mods are libraries or technical dependencies required for the main gameplay mods to work correctly.

## Recommended

* Start a new world
* Make backups before updating
* Allocate at least 6 GB of RAM
* Do not add many extra mods without testing compatibility

## Requirements

* Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Java 21
* Recommended RAM: 6 GB or more

## Support the Project

Grandia Dungeons Modpack is a passion project made with a lot of time spent on dungeon gameplay, balancing, custom UI, multiplayer testing, bug fixing and future content.

If you enjoy the modpack and want to support its development, you can leave a voluntary donation here:

**DonationAlerts:** https://www.donationalerts.com/r/momooff

Donations help with new dungeon floors, bosses, enemies, loot, class balancing, UI improvements, multiplayer testing and future updates.

Donations are completely optional. The modpack remains playable without donating.

## Status

Grandia Dungeons Modpack is in active development. Balance, dungeon generation, classes, loot, bosses, UI, multiplayer systems and progression may change between versions.

## Disclaimer

Grandia Dungeons Modpack is not an official Minecraft product and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Third-party mods included in the pack belong to their respective authors.
